headline: Democratizing Security for the Agentic Web with Cloudflare CTO Dane Knecht
summary: In the transition to the agentic web, security has become an afterthought. Now, organizations are racing to figure out what AI security means, and how to keep their data safe. Live from Cloudflare Connect, Sarah Guo sits down with Cloudflare CTO Dane Knecht to discuss the changing attacker landscape
title: Democratizing Security for the Agentic Web with Cloudflare CTO Dane Knecht
